item.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of '2' in Statistics
item.description: The title is a reference to The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Mathematics in the Natural Sciences. I had a similar question about the number 2 which repeatedly shows up in engineering and science, specifically in the form of the 2-norm of a vector, and seems surprisingly effective at doing what it’s supposed to do.
